epics.sixSigmaMetric: Design mockup fidelity score >= 99.5% and 0 visual regression defects
epics.tocConstraintRef: UI presentation layer styling and layout rendering
requirements: R1: Implement pixel-perfect styling, responsive typography, and navigation bar matching approved design mockup 20261117221022-mockup in the standalone web view.
R2: Verify WCAG 2.1 AAA accessibility contrast ratios, skip-to-content links, and mobile layout viewports down to 375px without horizontal overflow.

slices.title: Implement approved design mockup 20261117221022 into standalone web interface
slices.jtbd: When implementing design updates for this epic, I want to apply the approved mockup layout, color tokens, and accessible controls, so that the knowledge base user experience matches the approved design benchmark.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261117221022-mockup/mockup.html
When static index UI and Svelte templates are updated to match the design assets and styles
Then visual hierarchy, colors, typography clamp values, and spacing match the mockup specification
Given a mobile viewport of 375px width
When inspecting the updated page layout
Then no horizontal overflow occurs and all interactive controls remain operable with WCAG AAA contrast
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Visual regression delta <= 0.1% against approved mockup
